entities.name: Zhang Wei
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zhang Wei is a female Chinese basketball player who was part of the teams that won gold medals at the 2006 Asian Games and the 2010 Asian Games. She competed at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing. She is the twin sister of Zhang Yu.
